Recorded at v4416. Arrived 2026-09-02 and was invisible to the orrery's ejecta baseline until
v4329, which is its own recorded finding.

RE-VENDORED 2026-09-08: 0.178.0 -> 0.185.1, after tools/ship/three-probe.json settled the question
README.md's own history section describes -- the earlier pin was one build box's WebGPU implementation
lagging the spec, not a fact about the fleet. Same three files, same one-line edit, same LICENSE grant.

EVIDENCE:
  - LICENSE reads "Copyright © 2010-2026 three.js authors" -- the same grant as vendor/three, year
    advanced by the re-vendor.
  - README.md beside this file records the npm registry URL the artifact was fetched from.
  - github.com/mrdoob/three.js appears 8 times in this directory, against 3 for
    selfshadow/ltc_code, which is a technique reference inside the area-light shader and not a
    source of these bytes.

NOTE: this is the same upstream project as vendor/three, vendored twice as two different builds.
The orrery draws them as two bodies and attributes both to "three.js authors", which is correct
about the grant and worth knowing when reading the author view: one author, two planets.
